\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\begin{equation}\label{eq:regression}
\begin{split}R_{k}\left( t \right) = e^{\left\lbrack - \left( \lambda_{k}t + \left( \frac{T_{\text{Ck} - 1} + t}{\alpha_{k}} \right)^{\beta_{k}} \right) \right\rbrack} \cdot e^{\left\lbrack - \left( \sum_{i = 1}^{i = k - 1}{\lambda_{i}T_{i}} \right) \right\rbrack} \cdot e^{\left\lbrack - \left( \sum_{i = 1}^{i = k - 1}\left( \frac{T_{\text{Ci}}}{\alpha_{i}} \right)^{\beta_{i}} \right) \right\rbrack}\end{split}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
